title: In a Q&A, Trump discusses Dario Amodei's views differing greatly from "what is portrayed in the media", meetings with AI leaders, "Super Intelligence", and more (Time)
summary: Time: In a Q&A, Trump discusses Dario Amodei's views differing greatly from “what is portrayed in the media”, meetings with AI leaders, “Super Intelligence”, and more — President Donald Trump sat down for an interview with TIME at the White House on Sept. 28.
